mapping.root_evidence: size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;
mapping.reason: Step 3 is the dispatch gate that admits the request into the PROXY parser. Step 5 is the root cause: the length check compares against the struct size rather than the actual buffer capacity, allowing an oversized frame to pass validation and later cause an overflow. Step 7 is a downstream consumer that uses the shifted pointer and adjusted size in a memmem scan, which can operate on an invalid region and turn the overflow into a security-visible effect.
